goal: Improve the current Herrerasaurus first image by preserving the stronger long-arm full-body candidate while replacing only the open, toothy head with the calmer closed-jaw comparison head.

experiments.finding: Rejected. It preserved the stronger striped body and long forelimbs, but the source lower jaw remained as a faint ghost below the closed head.
Selected. The wider mask removes the ghost lower jaw while preserving the long-arm body, tail, legs, ground, and striped surface detail from the current primary.

decision.reason: This is a conservative local improvement over the previous first image: it fixes the open-mouth/head issue without changing the existing count-level full-body gate. Fingers, toes, and exact hand anatomy still need later reference-specific work.
decision.nextRoute: Use this as the app-first Herrerasaurus candidate; future work should target hand/foot detail with a focused early-saurischian guide or LoRA rather than broad whole-body regeneration.
